title: Qualify Duo 27.1 same-key manual ownership
admission: User supplies a newly available Duo27.1 simulator restricted to Xcode27.1. This makes the existing EXP-129/H01 ownership discriminator executable in the intended device family; no new telemetry family or release gate.

environment_discovery.mcp_boundary: Rediscovered MCP service still reports SDK27.0; do not use it to launch the Duo. Pin every execution command to verified27.1.

protocol: Freeze source/fixture identities and signed-or-authorized-unsigned revision before build; fresh derived data, run ID and artifact directory.
Discover an eligible Duo27.1 simulator and its prior boot state; prove clean app absence before install; verify all installed executable identities.
Run the unchanged EXP-129 scenario first. Capture native scene IDs, activation/geometry sequence and terminal screenshot; capability declarations alone do not prove overlap.

Require genuine overlapping visible scenes before and throughout manual A/B start and B-before-A stop. Posted lifecycle, logical peers, serial background replacement and after-boundary checks cannot establish this prerequisite.
If the existing fixture cannot prove a prerequisite, preserve INCONCLUSIVE; freeze a bounded observation/readiness correction before a new run. Never weaken owner or occurrence assertions.

Query complete session-only backend inventories, bind exact synthetic Action/Resource IDs to mapper owners, and preserve unexpected events. Terminate/uninstall only the probe and restore prior boot state.
Stop after two equivalent simulator system failures before the decisive boundary; preserve every invalid/inconclusive attempt.

oracle.native: All original ordered semantic and completion expectations; distinct native scenes and Compose UUIDs; B stop leaves exact A Compose active; each returned Home has a fresh UUID; no automatic duplicate during manual authority.
oracle.backend: Exact seven named action/Resource marker pairs match mapper IDs, session IDs and owning view IDs; complete session view inventory agrees with mapper occurrences; zero unexpected error/crash events.
oracle.topology: Actual scene activation and geometry plus visible UI evidence at the critical interval; no assertion inferred from manifest capabilities.
oracle.cleanup: Exact protected file metadata/index state, frozen source/fixture identity, app/process absence and prior simulator boot state.

closure_rule: A complete run accepts this Duo simulator H01 slice only. H01 physical closure, F04 physical Duo acceptance, H11-H13 human gestures and F05 physical Replay remain separate and are not waived.
